column1: # The L1 apps in matrix build order (from alexandria/LAYER_ORDER.tsv, measured 2026-10-15).
# Build them in this order: each app comes after the layers its code leans on, so it can use them.
# position: build order among the unbuilt L1 apps; wave: its task directory; layer = slot;
# leaned_on_by: how many other layers lean on it; leans_on: layers its code uses (0 = the core).
